title: TOGED public sitemap
methodology_or_locator: Retrieved 2026-09-19. XML listed 70 public URLs. Each listed URL was fetched with curl using a standard browser user agent; page content was searched for employment terms and 10.777/10777.
assessment: No current TOGED-public national employment observation found. This inventories the published sitemap, not deleted/private/unindexed material.

title: Ticaret Bakanlığı Desteklerinde 5 Kritik Gelişme
methodology_or_locator: Published 13 Mar 2026; section '5. İstihdam Destekleri' gives domestic and foreign wage-support ceilings per person.
assessment: Primary TOGED release but excluded: support amounts do not state people employed or an industry workforce total.

title: TOGED homepage
methodology_or_locator: Homepage/about wording describes association membership and workforce-development objectives; no table, footnote or quantified workforce claim.
assessment: Primary association context only; member scope cannot supply a national employment count.

title: Oyun geliştiriciler teknolojiye de yön veriyor
methodology_or_locator: 16 Sep 2019; the 'İstihdam imkanları da büyüyor' passage attributes a qualitative statement to TOGED chair Ali Erkin.
assessment: No numeric workforce evidence or method. Excluded.

title: 2023 European Video Games Industry Insight Report
access_status: existing original packet; not redownloaded in this pass
methodology_or_locator: p. 57 employment-chart Turkey bar = 10,777; associated questionnaire/method notes define people included and excluded.
assessment: Existing accepted 2023 contextual marker only. No additional year obtained.

title: Gaming in Türkiye reports archive
methodology_or_locator: Already documented in the country research packet as market reports; task expressly excluded rechecking saved market PDFs.
assessment: No values used. Turnover, company and target figures are excluded from employment.
